title: UCI Bike Sharing: external daily demand case
citation: Fanaee-T, H. (2013). Bike Sharing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
acquisition: Download retains original ZIP/day.csv/Readme.txt, attribution, retrieval time, and hashes. New archives must match the SHA-256 verified by the initial real-data CI run; cached CSVs must match recorded provenance.
changes: No changes to cached day.csv. Prepared study selects dteday/cnt, constructs past-only lag features, and separates chronological splits.
limitations: Historical 2011–2012 rental counts; not present-day demand.
The full public file contains test labels. The workflow's holdout discipline is procedural, not access control.
Weather observations on the target date, casual/registered totals, and the target itself are excluded from forecast inputs.
